component.name: Call Switcher
component.summary: Place calls from tel: links through PhonixPBX, Asterisk ARI or a phone app

description.p: Call Switcher handles tel:, callto: and sip: links. It places the call through the click-to-call API of PhonixPBX, Asterisk ARI (originate) or a phone app such as Linphone.
With PhonixPBX or Asterisk your own desk phone rings first; once you answer, the number is dialed. If more than one method is enabled, Call Switcher asks which one to use.
